summary: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation, a Cayman-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 22, 2026 that reports voting results from its 2026 Annual General Meeting held the same date. Quorum was met with 135,372,262 of 135,632,940 ordinary shares represented. Proposal 1 re-elected directors Tsung-Ming Chung and Steve Chen with 118,534,106 votes for; Proposal 2 ratified Deloitte Touche as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. Both passed as ordinary resolutions. This is a routine meeting-result filing, not a special situation.
